name: CartSaver Chat Recovery
author: cartplugins

sections.description:
CartSaver Chat Recovery is the professional way to bring back lost customers. Version 1.0.4 introduces the Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API integration, allowing for 100% automated, reliable recovery messages.

FREE Features:
* Track pending, completed & abandoned carts.
* One-click WhatsApp manual recovery links.
* Modern Dashboard with recovery statistics.
* Capture billing phone numbers during checkout.
* Works with WooCommerce 5.0+.

Pro Upgrade (via Freemius):
* Automated WhatsApp Reminders: Send messages while you sleep.
* Official Meta Cloud API: Professional, reliable, and secure automation.
* Custom Recovery Delay: Choose to send reminders after 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, or 2h.
* Test Connection Tool: Verify your API setup instantly.
* Unlimited Carts: No limits on your recovery potential.

https://cartsaver.freemius.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cartsaver-chat-recovery folder to your plugins directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Visit the CartSaver menu in your sidebar.
  4. (Optional) Upgrade to Pro and configure your Meta API credentials for full automation.
sections.faq:
Does it require WhatsApp Business API?

The Free version uses free wa.me click-to-chat links. The Pro version supports the Official Meta WhatsApp Business API for full automation.

What is the benefit of the Meta API?

It allows for 100% automation. You don’t need to click buttons manually; the system sends the reminder based on your chosen delay.

Is there a cost for the Meta API?

Meta offers a free tier of 1,000 conversations per month for most businesses, making it very cost-effective for small to medium stores.

  • Feature: Added Test Connection tool to verify API settings.
  • Enhancement: Registered custom 15-minute cron interval for faster recovery.

1.0.3 – 2026-01-12

  • Initial release.
  • Cart tracking and manual WhatsApp integration.
